title: Citrus
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After her widowed mother remarries, outgoing Yuzu Aihara transfers to a strict all-girls school and clashes with the cold student council president Mei, who turns out to be her new stepsister and roommate. Content advisory: the series centers on a romance between the two high school stepsisters, and critics cited in Wikipedia object to repeated non-consensual physical contact that the story frames as part of the romance.
life_message: It centers personal feeling over family expectations and school rules; critics note it does not hold coercion to account.

content.note: Family estrangement and melodrama (Wikipedia; AniList Estranged Family).
Romance between teen stepsisters with non-consensual contact criticized by ANN, CBR, Okazu and Anime Feminist reviewers (Wikipedia reception; Yuri 99%, Inseki 92% tags; MangaDex suggestive).
Neglected children (Matsuri, Inori) and family pressure on Mei (Wikipedia).
Forced physical contact framed as romantic, per several critics (Wikipedia reception; database tags).

delivery.evidence: ANN's Rebecca Silverman credits the manga's use of reader hindsight: Mei's motives become clear only on rereading.
delivery.note: The romance is shown without commentary, and critics cited in Wikipedia say the coercion is never held to account.

winners_losers: Mei's family expectations and arranged engagements give way in the plot, and the deceptive teacher Amamiya is fired. Critics cited in Wikipedia say the story does not hold the coercion to account.
